question: Why does the wise one not delight in contact-born enjoyments?
premises: contact-born enjoyments are sources of pain
all external enjoyments are pain-causing and impermanent
inference: the wise one avoids delight in transient pleasures because they are pain-producing
uncertainties: fused commentary tokens are kept whole
plain_english: Contact-born enjoyments are pain-sources with beginning and end; the wise one does not delight in them.
